I will say WoW has a lot of superfluous content, but much of that content isn't designed for the new player wanting to reach end-game (and that experience has been greatly improved since Cataclysm), but for the level-capped player who wants something to do. Is it a ploy to maintain subscriptions? Yes. Does it work? Well enough, but obviously not every player is going to be interested in Battle Pets or general collecting of things.
